explication: International Telephone Input is a phone-number entry library with vanilla JavaScript and Angular, React, Svelte, and Vue integrations. Users choose a country and enter a number; the library supports formatting, E.164 output, and validation. The core tree separates UI, country data, formatting, and utility functions, while framework packages expose the component in their respective ecosystems. The site also includes a configurable live playground. The tree and README establish these capabilities, but sampled source is limited, so uncertain internal call paths are not shown.
